subject: mathematics
concept: Multiplying polynomials, including binomial by binomial (FOIL) and binomial by trinomial
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles (area model) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student uses an area-model tile arrangement to multiply two binomials, seeing all four resulting terms
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an unmultiplied polynomial pair to its correctly expanded product
exercise.abstract: Student multiplies given polynomials and simplifies the result

misconception_flags: misses one of the required multiplication terms when expanding (incomplete FOIL)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
